description: Creation of two additional self-contained flats by construction of a two-storey side to rear (wrap-around) extension, a single storey rear extension and front porch (following demolition of existing garages and rear extensions); a rear roof extension with Juliet balcony, installation of single rooflights to front, side and rear roof slopes; internal alterations to layout of existing flats; associated forecourt landscaping, cycle parking and refuse storage
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates shall be begun not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.
| The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with drawing title number(s): P103A (proposed block plan); P301C (proposed plans); P401C (proposed elevations)
Reason: For the avoidance of doubt, and in the interests of proper planning.

| All external materials to be used in the development shall match those indicated on the approved plans in Condition 2. The front door to the property shall be of timber construction and the existing paint to the exterior brick work shall be removed.

Reason: To ensure that the materials harmonise with the surroundings, in accordance with policies 1.1 & 1.2 of the Ealing Core Strategy (2012), policies 7.4 & 7B of the Ealing Development Management Development Plan Document (2013), policies 7.4 & 7.6 of the London Plan (2016); Draft New London Plan(2019) policies D1 and D4 and the National Planning Policy Framework (2019). | The proposed rooflights hereby approved shall not project more than 150mm from the roof plane and retained as such for the lifetime of the development

Reason: To ensure that the materials harmonise with the surroundings, in accordance with policies 1.1 & 1.2 of the Ealing Core Strategy (2012), policies 7.4 & 7B of the Ealing Development Management Development Plan Document (2013), policies 7.4 & 7.6 of the London Plan (2016); Draft New London Plan(2019) policies D1 and D4 and the National Planning Policy Framework (2019).

| Prior to occupation of the development, an enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w [and L'nT,w] of at least 5dB above the maximum Building Regulations value, for the floor/ceiling /wall structures separating different types of rooms/ uses in adjoining dwellings, namely bedroom adjacent to staircase, living/dining room and kitchen above/below bedroom of separate dwellings shall be implemented and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site is not adversely affected by noise, in accordance with Policies 3.5 and 7.15 of the London Plan 2016, policies 1.1(j) & 1.2(f) of the Ealing Development (Core) Strategy (2012) and with policies 3.5 and 7A of the Ealing's Development Management Plan Document. | No part of the flat roofs of the hereby approved development shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof terrace/garden or similar amenity area.

Reason: To protect the living conditions of occupants of nearby properties and future occupiers of the development, in accordance with policies 7A  and 7B of the Ealing Development Management Plan (2013); Draft New London Plan(2019) policies D1 and D4 and policy 7.6 of the London Plan (2016).

| Prior to occupation of the flats, the proposed forecourt planting including privet hedges along the front boundary and ornamental tree shall be completed. All planting shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development hereby approved.

Any planting that is part of the approved scheme that within a period of five years after planting is removed, dies or becomes seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season and all planting shall be replaced with others of a similar size and species and in the same position, and shall be retained thereafter.

Reason: To improve the visual amenity of the property through urban greening and in the interests of providing a sustainable environment for future occupiers of the development in accordance with policies 1.1 (f) (g) of the Development Strategy 2026 (2012); policies 7.4 and 7.5 of the London Plan (2016); The London Environment Strategy (2018); and policies 5.10, 7B and 7.4 of the Ealing Development Management DPD (2013) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2019) | Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, each rear garden space shall be provided with a garden shed and compost bin to be retained for the lifetime of the development.

Reason:  In the interests of future occupants for maintenance of their garden for their own enjoyment and the visual amenity of the locality, in the accordance with policies 5.10, 7.4 and 7B of the Ealing Development Management Development Plan Document (2013), policies 7.4 and of the London Plan (2016), the London Environment strategy (2018) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2019). | The residential units hereby approved shall at no time be converted from C3 residential to a C4 small HMO, notwithstanding the provisions of Schedule 2 Part 3 Class L of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order) without express planning permission having first been granted by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: : To prevent the overdevelopment of the site and to safeguard the living conditions of adjoining properties and visual appearance of the building, in accordance with policies 7.4 and 7B of the Ealing Development Management Development Plan Document (2013), policies 7.4 and of the London Plan (2016) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2019).

| Prior to occupation of the flats, a discreet timber screened refuse storage facility to accommodate bins for recycling and non- recycling shall be provided for all flats within the building with capacity in compliance with BS5906:2005, and retained thereafter.

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of appearance and setting for the development and to ensure that the proposed development enhances the visual amenity of the locality, in the interests of the amenities of the occupants of the development in accordance with policy 7B of the Ealing Development Management Development Plan Document (2013) | At least eight (8) secure cycle parking spaces shall be provided on site and retained thereafter
Reason: to encourage sustainable transport modes in accordance with London Plan (2016) policy 6.9 and table 6.3 and Draft New London Plan(2019)-intend to publish policy T5 and table 10.2
